evidence.commitMessage: fix: add build-time Vercel deployment config guard test
evidence.commitBody: Adds a Jest guard test that catches deployment configuration drift at npm test time — before it ever reaches production. This is a different approach from PR #1533's E2E bash test hardening (post-deploy detection). Guards five invariants: Dashboard .vercel/project.json links to leadflow-ai; Root .vercel/project.json does NOT link to leadflow-ai; next.config.ts exists; package.json build script uses next build; No vercel.json builds override. Root cause: the 2026-05-08 outage happened because server.js was deployed to the leadflow-ai project.

riskRationale: Change is additive (test file only, no production code). File path tests/__tests__/vercel-deployment-config.test.ts does not conflict with anything on main. Branch is 2+ months old but test content is still relevant — Vercel project config drift is an ongoing risk. Caveat: TypeScript test (.ts) requires ts-jest or babel-jest configured — compatibility should be verified before merging.
recommendationDetail: Branch contains a genuinely unshipped pre-deploy guard test (Jest unit test for Vercel deployment config invariants) that complements PR #1533's post-deploy E2E detection. The test guards the exact class of bug that caused the 2026-05-08 outage. A new task should be created to: (1) verify Jest TypeScript support is in place, (2) open a PR from this branch against main. Do NOT delete — the content has value that was never shipped.
